decision_summary: Promote the 512-thread shared-staging plus low-256-lane register-cache implementation of the exact-M32 residual-add and centered-RMSNorm kernel.

The selected C4 candidate reduces the 2,048 production kernel instances from a bracketed 62.402608 ms to 37.396384 ms, a 1.668680266x kernel speedup and 25.006224 ms saving over the already-promoted C0 kernel.
Two unprofiled P513 B-C-C-B pairs reduce the prefix bracket mean from 4,757.0760 to 4,729.5175 ms, or 27.5585 ms and 0.579316%, while finish-prefill is neutral.
C1 register-only, C2 512-thread shared-only, and C3 768-thread shared-only variants remain experimental worktree evidence and are not retained in production.

source.base_subject: kernels: fuse exact M32 residual RMSNorm
source.candidate_tree: uncommitted C4 kernel and resource/Graph test update on base_head
source.production_kernel_identity: The main and measurement binaries have identical complete kernel SASS after removing only the anonymous-namespace Function symbol line; normalized SHA-256 is f436fe5d4bc8c1e053841abe74dfc56a2e99628fc5e26d8c8aeb3f0038f0e1e5.

variants.description: Promoted 256-thread one-CTA-per-token kernel; global residual is reread for normalized output.
256-thread scalarized packed register cache; removes the global residual reread but retains only 16 resident warps per SM for the 32-CTA grid.
512-thread BF16 shared staging; raises producer parallelism but rereads the shared residual for output.
768-thread BF16 shared staging; each of 16 SMs receives exactly two CTAs, but output rereads shared residual.

512-thread producer writes identical rounded BF16 bits to global and shared memory; low 256 lanes preserve the original 20-value FMA sequence while caching ten packed BF16 pairs in registers for output.

C4_contract.producer_mapping: All 512 lanes cover dimensions tid+512*k exactly once, perform residual-left plus projection-right, round to BF16, and store the same bits to residual_output and shared_residual.
C4_contract.reduction_mapping: Only lanes 0..255 consume dimensions tid+256*k in k=0..19 order, preserving the original 20 dependent fmaf operations and 128,64,32,16,8,4,2,1 tree.
C4_contract.register_cache: The low lanes cache ten pairs of rounded BF16 bits across the reduction barriers. Output loads weights but performs no second global or shared residual read.
C4_contract.alias_safety: All 512 right inputs are consumed before the first block barrier and before normalized output can overwrite exact-right alias storage.
C4_contract.fallbacks_unchanged: Decode/M1, Prefill M2..M31, non-5120 shapes, and M31 tail tiles retain the prior path.

promotion.reason: C4 passes bitwise, NaN, alias, guard, replay, Graph, resource, compiled-mechanism, actual-model, hot-screen, production raw, and unprofiled P513 end-to-end gates. It exceeds the predeclared 1.05x production-context threshold over C0 by a wide margin.
promotion.scope: Exact M32 residual/RMSNorm boundaries only; the measured whole-P513 prefix improvement is 0.579%, not the 2.11x hot-chain or 1.669x production-kernel result.
promotion.next_work: Refresh the post-C4 phase profile and return to the much larger M32 NVFP4 gate/up and down-projection critical-path regions; do not continue polishing this now-subpercent whole-phase hotspot without new profile evidence.
